verdict.rationale: cubic documents two direct handoff paths. The cubic CLI reviews local changes and generates a prompt your coding agent can use to fix the findings. An official MCP server lets coding agents read review findings and triage PR or codebase-scan issues, with documented setup for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, VS Code and Gemini CLI, plus skills for handling PR comments. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent handoff, and no documented copyable fix prompt attached to individual PR review comments (the documented prompt generation is CLI-side).
